project_type: Next.js 16 + React 19 + TypeScript frontend for Odoo 18 accounting system (FMCG shop)
build_system: npm with Next.js - no test framework installed
test_framework: None - no test files exist in the project
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm install in frontend/ to install deps. 2. Run npm run build to check TypeScript compilation. 3. Verify no build errors.
environment_constraints: node_modules not installed yet - need npm install first. Odoo backend at localhost:8069 not available in sandbox. Verification limited to TypeScript build.
contribution_requirements: AGENTS.md says to read node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before writing code (but that dir does not exist). All UI must be RTL Persian with Vazirmatn font. Use existing patterns from odoo-api.ts, PriceInput, JalaliDatePicker.
key_patterns: Pages are 'use client' components in src/app/admin/<name>/page.tsx. API calls via odoo-api.ts functions (searchRead, create, write, callMethod, jsonRpc). State with useState/useEffect. Modals are fixed overlay divs. Filters use button groups. Tables with thead/tbody. Persian digits via toPersianDigits/formatPrice. Jalali dates via toJalali. Price inputs via PriceInput component. RTL layout with Tailwind classes.
directory_structure: frontend/src/app/admin/ - admin pages (accounting, accounts, credits, inventory, etc.). frontend/src/components/ - shared components (Sidebar, JalaliDatePicker, PriceInput). frontend/src/lib/ - utilities (odoo-api.ts, utils.ts). frontend/src/stores/ - zustand stores.
